description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation value across different layers for various components in a baseline model. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 22, and is marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value", also has a linear scale, spans from 0 to 1600, and is marked at intervals of 200. The plot displays four lines representing different components: "attn_output" (blue, dashed), "attn_residual" (orange, dotted), "ffn_output" (green, dash-dotted), and "ffn_residual" (red, solid). The "attn_output" line remains near 0 until layer 20, then rises to approximately 550 at layer 22. The "attn_residual" line stays near 0 until layer 5, then jumps to around 1400 at layer 6, remains steady until layer 18, and then gradually increases to about 1550 at layer 22. The "ffn_output" line is near 0 until layer 4, then surges to around 1400 at layer 5, drops to approximately 50 at layer 6, stays relatively stable until layer 17, and then rises sharply to about 600 at layer 20 before dropping back to around 50 at layer 21 and rising again to approximately 550 at layer 22. The "ffn_residual" line is near 0 until layer 4, then jumps to around 1450 at layer 5, remains relatively stable around 1500 between layers 6 and 19, and then drops to approximately 0 at layer 21.
